reviewed_items.original_title: Issue #455 R455-053: verify WCR sensory lexicon boundaries [skip netlify]
reviewed_items.original_body:
## Scope (Issue #455; Option B, research-only)

Direct primary-source review of Chambers et al. (2016), *Development of a “living” lexicon for descriptive sensory analysis of brewed coffee*, DOI [10.1111/joss.12237](https://doi.org/10.1111/joss.12237), crosschecked against [World Coffee Research’s official Sensory Lexicon](https://worldcoffeeresearch.org/resources/sensory-lexicon). Original lexicon work involved **trained assessors and 0–15 descriptive intensity reference scales**, most brewing was infusion/drip with some automated espresso, and authors explicitly flagged espresso-specific further work. This **does not validate the app’s owner-Locked five consumer 1–5 sliders, all-green targets or any new numeric taste/recipe policy**.

- Adds `LIT-2016-CHAMBERS-WCR-LEXICON`, bounded evidence checks `R455-EV-CIT-053-A/B`, and research-only proposal `R455-PROP-053-WCR-LEXICON-TO-FIVE-TASTE-UX`. Curated source register now **52 sources / 111 bounded evidence checks**, with source hash/access limitations explicitly recorded.
- Same-commit scoped work journal updates in `docs/workstreams/issue-455.md`; only this and the scoped evidence JSON change.
- Preserves all five taste inputs, all-green and missing-rating distinction, original measured shots/private notes/history, styles, Slow Feed, owner Locked decisions, active app code/tests, release queue and source originals. **No application, CI, provider, SQL/Auth/Edge/member data or production changes. No publication.** No #267 line-review credit.
- October 29 research pack remains research-only. Separate original S019 PDF still inaccessible; do not infer certification or close #455.

### Verification

Review exact head `b2aacafd5fa38c465668d6f456ca1a2b122ab2cc`, linked base `c6bdde7f255b17248ed9df680320f139e509248e`; ledger JSON parsed and ID/count uniqueness verified; branch/commit/tree/only-two-file diff read back. **Required: exact-source docs-only approval/governance/continuity CI before non-force merge**. Node/browser/offline/SQL/Auth not applicable to docs-only research; do not misreport as passed. Preserve concurrent branches.
